feeds.title: Mindfulmazing Blog
feeds.description: Whether you are looking for fun family night ideas, resources for your home or classroom, or calm down corner ideas, we've got everything you need! I initially created Mindfulmazing for my son, so that he could grow up in a supported, positive, and encouraging environment. But we're now a community that's grown into thousands of teachers, parents, and practitioners from around the world, all passionate and raising our youth in a supported environment.

feeds.title: Simply Rooted Family
feeds.description: There are proven ways to hard wire a child's brain for happiness pathways. Raise happy and resilient kids with these positive parenting tips. Hi! I am Renee, owner of Simply Rooted Family. I am here to help you raise kids that are healthy at home, so they can be strong in the world. I am a certified Mindfulness Parenting Practitioner, and I have my doctorate in pharmacy.

feeds.title: Parenting OC » Mindfulness
feeds.description: Find articles on healthy and mindful parenting, easier parent-child relationships, family-focused activities and events and more! Established for over 25 years, we are Orange County's leading family/parenting publication. With a readership of more than 300,000, we are committed to provide our readers with useful information and family-geared entertainment.

feeds.title: Mindful Little Minds
feeds.description: Mindful parenting support & play based tools that build emotion regulation skills. So you can become the calm, confident parent you've always wanted to be. Mindful Little Minds was founded by Sarah Conway, a child and adolescent psychologist with a passion for improving the emotional health of all children. Our printable resources, courses and online mindful parenting membership have been created by a child psychologist, to help you and your child learn to manage your big emotions - together.

feeds.title: The Mindful Motherhood Blog
feeds.description: Find relevant topics about mindful parenting techniques you can easily incorporate into your everyday life on the Mindful Motherhood Blog. The Mindful Motherhood Blog was created after my oldest son attended a childcare program that specialized in mindful and respectful caregiving. I was immediately drawn to the notion of tapping into our parental instincts and rethinking how we view our relationship with our children.

feeds.title: Refined Prose
feeds.description: Explore articles on Personal Growth & Journaling For a More Positive Mindset Proven self improvement techniques to help you reframe your circumstances for improved wellbeing. I'm Kate: devoted WAHM and wife, personal growth and mindful motherhood advocate, breastfeeding and CMPA supporter, environmentalist, and small-person referee.

feeds.title: Dr. Denise McDermott » Mindful Parenting
feeds.description: Dr. Denise McDermott, M.D. has been in private practice since 2001. As a medical doctor with board certifications in both Adult and Child Psychiatry, she treats children, adolescents and adults. Her goal is to empower you, your child, and your family to live the best life possible. Her approach is to encourage people to believe in wellness, not illness, and to lead a balanced healthy lifestyle.

feeds.title: Liberated Young » Mindful Parenting
feeds.description: Get updates on new learning products, the latest insights and tools for parents and educators, and initiatives from the Liberated Young community. Liberated Young is a community initiative about Black homeschooling, self-directed education, and liberation. It has since evolved into a more holistic resource for Black parents, educators, and people who want to get free.

feeds.title: Rachel Hawkes Mindful Parenting Blog
feeds.description: Find Mindful Parenting tips for creating more mindful moments with your family. This site is designed for those parents looking for simple ways of adding in more kids mindfulness activities. With ideas for all ages and also tips for parents too, there really is something for everyone.
